name: board
about: Getting in, in a hurry but with weight: a crouch and leap to the knee piston's head, a swinging hang, a haul up, a hop onto the knee, a jump to the roof's edge and a roll over it, a run to the hatch, down through it from its rim, a slide into the chair. Animated as a full rig (two-bone arms and legs); each arm part has its bottom at the wrist and its middle at the elbow, each leg part its bottom at the ankle and its middle at the knee.
frame: the mech frame at rest (+X left, +Y up, +Z forward, meters), with the mech kneeling and its turret ahead; limbs are directions in the body frame (left, up, forward), off their sockets by 'off'

keys.note: beside the front leg, facing the knee piston
sink into a crouch, arms swing back
the catch jolts; swing under the grip
kick the feet up onto the cylinder
reach up for the knee guard
spring up onto the knee guard
turn to the torso, reach for the roof's edge
haul up, feet scrabbling on the plate
roll over the edge, a knee on top
step to the hatch, turning to it
sit on the rim, legs into the hole
lower down onto the floor, holding the rim
